trans-unit.source: DeepL V3 API base URL. Use https://api.deepl.com for DeepL API Pro or https://api-free.deepl.com for DeepL API Free. Enter only the host, no endpoint path.
trans-unit.target: URL di base dell'API DeepL V3. Utilizza https://api.deepl.com per DeepL API Pro o https://api-free.deepl.com per DeepL API Free. Inserisci solo l'host, nessun percorso dell'endpoint.
